description: This Java class 'RecurringDepositTransactionImportHandler' handles the import of recurring deposit transactions into the application. It reads Excel sheets, processes transaction data, and submits commands to an underlying platform service to create or modify transactions, while reporting success and errors.

classes.name: RecurringDepositTransactionImportHandler
classes.description: Service class responsible for importing recurring deposit transactions from Excel files into the system, processing each transaction and invoking platform commands.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main entry point that triggers reading and importing transactions from a workbook, given locale and date format.

methods.name: readExcelFile
methods.description: Reads the Excel sheet to extract a list of savings account transactions.

methods.name: readSavingsTransaction
methods.description: Reads a single row from the sheet and constructs a SavingsAccountTransactionData object.

methods.name: importEntity
methods.description: Processes the list of transaction data, submits commands to the platform, and updates the Excel sheet with success/error statuses.
